question: Reckless Crew creates tokens and lets me attach an Equipment I control to each of them. If I attach several Equipment to the tokens, do they all become attached at the same moment?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: every Equipment you choose becomes attached at the same time.
expected.answer: All Equipment you decide to attach to tokens become attached at the same time.

source.license: Reproduced from the official Wizards of the Coast card-ruling text distributed for use by Magic: The Gathering tools and reference sites; this project already commits and serves this exact rulings corpus in production (see committedDataPath) as its card-ruling retrieval source.
source.questionAuthorship: The question is this project's own natural-language phrasing of a scenario the cited card's official ruling directly answers; the answer is the ruling's text, verbatim.

whyHard: Players assume attaching happens one piece of Equipment at a time, which would leave room for something to happen in between.
